title: RMSNorm and SwiGLU
summary: What a modern decoder block changes in the norm and the feed-forward.

choices.text: After training, the SwiGLU gate is dropped, so inference has the same FLOPs as a ReLU feed-forward of hidden size 4d.
SwiGLU has three weight matrices, so its hidden width is often set near (8/3) times the model width rather than 4 times, to match the parameter count of a two-matrix feed-forward.
RMSNorm divides by the root mean square of the vector and does not subtract the mean.
RMSNorm also drops the learned per-channel scale, and that missing scale is where most of its savings over LayerNorm come from.
